acceptance_criteria: Pythonの本番候補は依存版を固定し、未導入のLean/Kaniを成功扱いしない
scope: scripts/check_toolchains.py --require-locked-python runs in the locked CI job and fails unless every package of requirements-py313.lock is installed at its locked version. Lean (pinned 4.19.0) and Kani are only reported, as not_installed, version_mismatch or available; the script runs no proof and reports formal_proofs_run_here: false, so a missing toolchain is never counted as a pass. No workflow installs a proof toolchain; CI checks the recorded Lean evidence by its hashes only.
